security.csp: default-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Lightweight desktop chat client for OpenAI-compatible and Ollama endpoints.
bundle.longDescription: Chat Studio is a desktop chat client for OpenAI-compatible providers (OpenRouter, NVIDIA NIM) and Ollama, with local SQLite history, streaming responses, and MCP tool support.
